summary: At the height of a Cooperative celebration, Liora notices a repeating corridor-timing drift that does not belong in the era’s supposedly perfect system.
panelPlan: Wide establishing page: Cooperative Hall at ceremonial peak, gold-white banners, delegates moving confidently beneath stable green corridor maps.
Move through the polished celebration to Liora standing slightly apart, checking a handheld timing readout while everyone else watches the ceremony.
Insert on the readout: a tiny timing ripple repeats at the same interval instead of behaving like random noise.
Close on Liora as the pattern repeats again; the page ends with the first private certainty that something is wrong.
directionInline: The celebration must feel genuinely stable and successful so the small anomaly reads as a rupture in an otherwise trusted world.

summary: Liora brings the repeating drift to Lochran; he treats the pattern as an artifact of interpretation rather than a warning.
panelPlan: Open on Liora crossing the busy hall toward Lochran while the ceremony continues around them without interruption.
Two-shot: Liora turns the handheld so Lochran can see the repeating variance against the clean public corridor map behind him.
Close on Lochran studying the data long enough to show he understands it before choosing a calmer interpretation.
Reverse on Liora as Lochran dismisses the pattern as something produced by looking too hard for one.
End with the public display behind them still glowing green while Liora’s handheld continues to pulse off-time.
directionInline: Lochran should not look foolish or oblivious; his choice is to discount uncertain evidence in favor of institutional stability.

summary: Damiar steps into the dispute and deliberately shifts the question from accuracy to language, establishing reassurance as the Cooperative’s first response.
panelPlan: Damiar joins Liora and Lochran at the edge of the ceremony, reading both faces before speaking.
Medium group composition: Liora holds the anomalous data; Lochran remains composed; Damiar positions himself between technical concern and public spectacle.
Close on Damiar choosing his words while delegates and cameras remain visible beyond him.
Liora looks past him toward the corridor map, understanding that the problem is already becoming a messaging problem.
End on the ceremony continuing smoothly under his call for steady language.
directionInline: The page turn should land on the contrast between unresolved physical evidence and the institution’s immediate instinct to manage tone.

summary: Nereth shows Liora that one convoy has been logged as arriving twice at the same time, turning her subtle timing drift into a concrete anomaly.
panelPlan: Establish the Beacon Harmonization Authority Nexus: layered traffic telemetry, synchronized arrival streams, operators working inside a culture of precision.
Nereth isolates two identical arrival records and pulls them forward from the traffic field.
Insert: both records carry the same convoy identity and the same timestamp, impossible under normal routing.
Liora compares the duplicate arrival to her earlier drift pattern rather than reacting to it as a clerical error.
End on the two identical records hanging side by side.
directionInline: The duplicate arrival should be immediately readable to a nontechnical reader as impossible, not buried in interface clutter.

summary: Liora identifies the anomaly as echo-lag: the corridor itself is flexing enough for one arrival to register twice.
panelPlan: Begin tight on Liora tracing the mismatch from arrival logs back into the corridor timing data.
Visualize the same convoy path as two nearly overlapping traces rather than as abstract equations alone.
Nereth watches the traces separate by a fraction and then realign.
Liora names the effect: echo-lag, a physical elasticity problem rather than a scheduling failure.
End on the route visualization subtly bowing out of alignment.
directionInline: Keep the science legible through cause and image: one path, two temporal impressions.

summary: Nereth states the practical consequence of echo-lag: if it spreads, the network will no longer agree with reality about when ships arrive.
panelPlan: Nereth expands the anomaly across neighboring route data to test whether the duplicate was isolated.
Several clean routes remain stable, then one distant trace flickers with the same small offset.
Two-shot: Nereth and Liora understand that the first anomaly may already have company.
Close on Nereth spelling out what happens when arrival records and physical arrival cease to match.
End on the Nexus traffic wall, still orderly at a glance but now containing more than one impossible timestamp.
directionInline: Finish Issue 1’s first technical sequence on operational consequence, not terminology.

summary: At Astrin Hall’s cultural festival, a delegation arrives late enough to break a ceremony designed around perfect corridor timing.
panelPlan: Wide, bright festival page: performers, lanterns, audience, and an event sequence whose elegance depends on exact arrival timing.
Heska records the event as the expected delegation fails to appear at its assigned cue.
The performance is forced to hold and improvise while organizers exchange confused looks.
The delegation finally enters at the wrong moment, visibly interrupting the choreography.
End on Heska lowering her recorder instead of applauding.
directionInline: Make the disruption socially visible but not catastrophic; the unsettling fact is that this almost never happens.

summary: Heska catches the same temporal inconsistency in the festival record and realizes that the celebrated system has produced a contradiction history will have to explain.
panelPlan: The announcer recovers smoothly and publicly welcomes the late delegation as if nothing consequential occurred.
Heska checks the archival timestamp attached to the arrival while applause resumes around her.
Insert on the timestamp glitch pulsing behind the official event record.
Close on Heska’s expression as she recognizes that the archive and lived sequence no longer line up cleanly.
End with the festival continuing beautifully while her recorder holds the inconsistency.
directionInline: The page should preserve the contrast between public grace and private archival alarm.

summary: Heska brings the festival discrepancy into the Records Vault and discovers metadata offsets that do not match any archival standard.
panelPlan: Establish the Records Vault as quiet, ordered, and built around trust in stable metadata.
Heska lays the festival record beside earlier Cooperative logs and sorts by arrival timestamp.
Offsets appear where the archive should be internally consistent.
She checks the standard twice rather than assuming user error.
End on several unrelated records showing the same kind of temporal displacement.
directionInline: Treat the archive anomaly as evidence accumulation, not supernatural corruption.

summary: Liora connects Heska’s archival offsets to corridor drift and explains that a small physical error becomes dangerous when propagated through an interconnected system.
panelPlan: Liora joins Heska at the archive table, with technical corridor data layered over historical metadata.
The same offset pattern appears in both systems when the displays are aligned.
Liora traces one small timing error through multiple dependent records and routes.
Heska watches the error multiply outward instead of staying local.
End on Liora’s warning that interconnected drift scales catastrophically.
directionInline: Make the multiplying dependence visible: the threat comes from propagation through a trusted network.

summary: Heska understands that if corridor timing can distort records, the Cooperative may eventually lose confidence not only in transit but in its own account of what happened.
panelPlan: Quiet page after Liora’s explanation: rows of archive stacks extend beyond the two women.
Heska compares a physical event record, a corridor log, and an official narrative entry that no longer align perfectly.
Liora does not offer reassurance; she studies the mismatch with the same concern.
Close on Heska’s recorder reflecting three slightly different timestamps.
End on the vault’s ordered lights receding into depth, visually intact but epistemically less trustworthy.
directionInline: Do not add new exposition. Let the visual implication carry the existential concern already present in the source scene.

summary: Damiar drafts the Cooperative’s response alone, testing phrases that minimize the anomaly without technically denying it.
panelPlan: Open on Damiar alone in a quieter chamber adjacent to the celebration spaces.
Projected draft lines hover around him with increasingly softened alternatives for drift, anomaly, and risk.
He deletes a sharper warning and replaces it with calmer language.
Close on him rehearsing the statement while adjusting his collar and presentation.
End on the polished version ready for transmission.
directionInline: Show that Damiar is making a conscious trade: he believes calm is part of his duty, not merely a cynical cover.

summary: The reassurance message goes out across the same network whose timing is beginning to fail, allowing the public story of stability to outrun the evidence.
panelPlan: Begin on Damiar initiating the official communication.
Cut across public screens in transit halls and civic spaces receiving the calm statement.
People relax or return to routine because the message sounds authoritative and ordinary.
Intercut one screen with a nearby arrival display that flickers off-time for a fraction of a second.
End on the reassurance continuing while the anomaly remains physically unresolved.
directionInline: This page extends the existing communication action visually without adding new spoken claims beyond Damiar’s source line.

summary: At Orban-Tier Transit Port, a traveler discovers that her sister’s convoy appears twice in the arrival system and demands to know which arrival is real.
panelPlan: Wide port page: travelers move beneath arrival boards that begin to flicker between stable and conflicting states.
A concerned traveler finds the same convoy listed in two places or times and pushes toward a service point.
Insert on the duplicate listing tied to her sister’s convoy.
She confronts the transit controller as nearby passengers begin listening.
End on the question that turns an abstract anomaly into a family crisis.
directionInline: Keep the traveler specific and human; this is the first page where the system failure directly reaches an ordinary family.

summary: The transit controller cannot reconcile the two timestamps and falls back on procedure while the crowd begins to sense that procedure no longer answers the problem.
panelPlan: The controller cycles through internal routing windows and gets conflicting results.
Travelers bunch beneath the boards as blank states and duplicate arrivals alternate overhead.
The controller asks everyone to remain in designated lanes because no cleaner instruction is available.
Reaction panels show that the crowd hears the procedural language as evasion.
End on the controller still unable to identify one authoritative arrival window.
directionInline: The controller is overwhelmed, not villainous. Procedure is failing faster than staff can adapt.

summary: Aveth steadies the traveler and crowd even though he cannot yet prove the convoy is safe, revealing the moral burden of reassurance on the ground.
panelPlan: Aveth moves into the service area between the anxious traveler and the overloaded controller.
He asks for a clean signal check while physically creating space around the console.
Close on Aveth telling the traveler her family is safe even as the evidence remains incomplete.
The traveler holds onto the promise because there is nothing else solid to hold.
End on Aveth looking back at the unstable boards after the traveler turns away.
directionInline: Aveth’s reassurance should feel compassionate and risky, distinct from institutional messaging even though both withhold uncertainty.

summary: Before the Council session, Lochran instructs Damiar to keep the briefing centered on continuity rather than projected turbulence.
panelPlan: Establish a quiet Cooperative Hall antechamber moments before the Council convenes.
Lochran and Damiar review draft briefing language beside a live corridor map.
Lochran directs attention away from projected turbulence and toward continuity.
Damiar edits the language in real time while watching the red warning terms disappear.
End on the chamber doors preparing to open.
directionInline: Keep this scene restrained; the tension comes from deliberate framing immediately before formal decision-making.

summary: Damiar agrees to translate the crisis into reassurance, but his hesitation shows that he now understands the technical warning is real.
panelPlan: Damiar reads the revised briefing one last time.
Close on a phrase about routine fluctuation beside Liora’s much sharper underlying model.
He gives Lochran the answer Lochran needs and commits to the calmer framing.
Lochran enters the Council chamber first; Damiar remains behind for one beat.
End on Damiar following with the softened briefing.
directionInline: Damiar’s uncertainty should be visible but not melodramatic; he is still choosing the institution’s approach.

summary: The Council convenes expecting a contained technical briefing; Liora instead brings a model showing corridor tension accelerating across the network.
panelPlan: Wide Council chamber page with delegates arranged around a floor-scale corridor projection.
Liora takes the presentation position while Lochran and Iskari watch from opposing sides of the chamber.
The model begins with familiar green network geometry.
Red-gradient tension bands emerge and extend farther than the room expects.
End on murmurs spreading as the projection stops looking local.
directionInline: Use the page to establish the political room and the scale of the model before the core argument begins.

summary: Liora states plainly that the drift curve is accelerating and that mounting network tension is now visible in the model.
panelPlan: Open on the projected curve rising rather than flattening.
Liora walks the Council through the pattern as red bands propagate across multiple connected arcs.
Close on Liora delivering the conclusion without hedging.
Cut to delegates recalculating what they thought was a minor anomaly.
End on Lochran remaining composed while the room’s confidence changes around him.
directionInline: Liora’s authority should come from clarity and evidence, not grandstanding.

summary: Iskari publicly backs Liora’s model, turning a technical warning into the first visible fracture inside Cooperative leadership.
panelPlan: Iskari studies the model and rises from her seat before Lochran can close the discussion.
She identifies the model as sound and names the risk of delaying action.
Reaction panel: Liora registers that she finally has institutional support.
Reaction panel: Lochran recognizes that the disagreement is now public rather than internal.
End on the chamber divided visually between those leaning toward the model and those holding position.
directionInline: This is the first unmistakable leadership fracture; stage it as a shift in the room, not merely another line of dialogue.

summary: Lochran refuses to trigger alarm on projections, ending the issue with leadership choosing calm over intervention even after the warning becomes public.
panelPlan: Begin on Lochran standing into the divided room rather than answering Liora privately.
He rejects escalation without disputing every detail of the model.
Close on Liora absorbing that evidence alone will not move the institution.
Iskari remains standing, making the split impossible to hide.
Final wide panel: the Council returns to procedural order while the red tension model still stretches across the floor beneath them.
directionInline: End the issue on institutional choice, with the unresolved red model remaining physically present under the restored surface calm.
